YOUR CHECKLIST04 ITEMS
South African IDTo verify who you are

Identity details help match you to the correct records. An ID alone does not show all your debts.

Proof of registrationTo confirm current enrolment

A current university registration document helps confirm your student status beyond your email address.

Proof of residenceTo verify your address

A recent document showing your residential address would be requested during a real application.

Three months of statementsYour latest consecutive months

Statements help assess recurring allowance or income, living expenses and existing repayments. They are not uploaded in this preview.

When applications open, Buddy will explain each request before asking for a document.
